item.title: UX/UI Website Design Specialist
item.description:
250-750 USD | Our in-house dev team turns out a steady stream of new web builds and redesigns—from revenue-driven e-commerce stores to polished corporate sites and creative portfolios. I need a dedicated UX/UI designer who can slot straight into that flow, shaping each project from first sketch to hand-off.
Here’s how the collaboration will work: you’ll join at the discovery stage, translate requirements into user flows and site maps, move on to low- and high-fidelity wireframes, then polish the final UI in Figma, Sketch or Adobe XD. Responsive behaviour, accessibility best practices and smooth developer hand-off are table stakes for every build.
Deliverables for each project • User journeys, site maps and personas • Annotated wireframes (mobile-first, then desktop) • Pixel-perfect UI mock-ups with component libraries • Clickable prototype to validate interactions • Final asset package and style guide for the dev team
To gauge fit, I need to see past work that demonstrates your process as well as the finished visuals—live links or case studies are perfect. If you’ve shipped e-commerce checkouts, corporate lead-gen sites AND portfolio-style experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
We move fast, iterate openly in Slack and Figma, and value designers who can balance fresh ideas with practical constraints. Show me what you’ve built, and let’s craft exceptional web experiences together.

item.title: Jetski Platform Landing Design
item.description:

The page has to look and read like the natural next step after someone views tdocks.com or the Facebook page, so the visuals must match the brand’s clean, rugged marine style while the copy highlights the key product benefits and drives an unmistakable call to action. Here’s what I need from you: polished graphic design (preferred tools are Figma, Adobe XD or Sketch—whatever you’re fastest in) plus concise, conversion-oriented copy. The structure I have in mind is a bold hero image with headline and lead-capture form, a benefits strip that explains why tdock beats fixed docks or manual trolley systems, and a sticky action button that never lets the visitor forget to enquire.
Deliverables • Layered design file ready for hand-off (desktop + mobile breakpoints) • All copy written directly in the design or as a separate doc • Any licensed images or icon sets used, with proof of license (or my images)
Acceptance criteria will be a design that loads fast, places the form above the fold on mobile, and uses no more than three core colours from the existing palette unless a strong UX argument is made.
When you reply, point me to past work that shows you can combine graphics and persuasive copy on a high-impact landing page. No need for lengthy proposals—your portfolio pieces will do the talking.

item.title: Build a Minimalist, Professional Dog-Training Website
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Website Designer Needed – Professional, Minimalist Dog Training Website
I'm looking for an experienced and creative designer to build a beautiful, professional website for my Australian-based dog training business, which offers services locally and online to clients around the world. I'm particularly interested in someone with a strong eye for aesthetics, visual branding, and clean, minimalist design. I want the website to feel polished, welcoming, and professional, while being easy for clients to navigate and book. I already have branding assets, including a logo, brand colours, social media content, photographs, and AI-generated imagery. My colour palette is warm browns, creams, beiges, tans, and other neutral tones. I'd like the designer to use these existing brand elements to create a cohesive, visually appealing site. Ideally, they would be comfortable reviewing my Instagram and selecting suitable photos or imagery that would complement the site. I'm happy for the designer to use their creativity with layouts, imagery, typography, and any other presentation ideas, as long as everything remains consistent with my branding.
Website Pages Required The website should include four main pages, plus separate terms and conditions pages. 1. Home Page - Introduces the business. - Gives a brief overview of what I offer. - Includes clear "Book Now" buttons. - Includes links to any current promotions or their terms and conditions.
2. About Page - My background and history. - Information about my experience. - Relevant photographs, including images from my previous dog training business.
3. Services & Pricing Page - A list of the different services I offer. - Individual service prices and package pricing breakdowns. - Relevant booking options.
4. Contact Page - My contact details. - Links to my social media accounts. - A simple contact form.
5. Additional Terms & Conditions Pages - Separate pages for relevant terms and conditions. - Accessible through appropriate links from the home page or other relevant sections.
Booking System Booking is already set up through Square, so I do not need a bespoke booking system built. I simply need clear buttons or links directing clients to my existing Square booking page.
Overall Goal The main focus of this project is strong aesthetic design that makes my brand feel credible, professional, and inviting, while providing a simple, user-friendly experience for potential clients.

Show me links to similar blog builds you’ve completed, outline your preferred stack, timeline, and an all-inclusive quote.

item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed -- 4
item.description:
250-750 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. No PBNs, link farms, spam directories, or paid link networks. Paid placements require written approval in advance. - Technical SEO: keep Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog warnings at zero. Fix redirects, 404s, indexing, schema, and speed issues. - Conversion engineering: every page has a clear value proposition, benefit-driven H1, primary call to action, trust elements, and verified event tracking. - First 30 days: establish a documented baseline for organic sessions, leads, registrations, purchases, and conversion rate, and propose weekly/monthly growth targets for approval. Then report baseline vs. target vs. actual every Friday.
Member Website Publishing - Own customer website publishing requests from intake to completion: connect domains, verify DNS and SSL, publish the site, test layouts/forms/links, and confirm completion with the customer. - Set up staging builds and handle customer DNS updates. - Occasional quick WordPress pages or micro-sites using native Gutenberg blocks.
Tools You Will Use WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and our internal SEO dashboard (keyword pipeline, page generator, rank tracker).
Requirements - Proven WordPress experience: themes, plugins, staging, backups, troubleshooting. - Working SEO knowledge: on-page, technical, keyword research, and manual link outreach. - Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Gutenberg block editor experience (no third-party page builders). - Strong written English for daily and weekly reports. - Reliable internet and consistent daily availability. - You own routine fixes yourself and escalate only access, budget, security, or major platform decisions — with evidence and a recommended next step.
How We Measure Success (KPIs) - 100 new quality-checked SEO pages per month - 100 audited quality backlinks per month - Site load under 3 seconds; zero open technical warnings at week end - Weekly acquisition report every Friday; keyword report every Monday - Zero broken pages, forms, or layouts left open past 24 hours - Organic sessions, leads, registrations, and purchases growing against the approved baseline
How To Apply Send: (1) a short intro, (2) links to 2–3 WordPress sites you have managed or built, (3) one example of SEO results you produced (traffic, rankings, or links — with dates), and (4) your expected monthly rate. Applicants who complete our verification of your organic traffic growth, move to the front.

The core storefront will sit on WordPress, yet I also expect custom functionality that may tap into standalone PHP or even .NET components, so a good grasp of all three will be useful.
Here’s what I need:
• Clean WordPress installation configured for e-commerce • A lightweight theme tailored to digital downloads, fully responsive • Payment gateway integration (credit cards and PayPal at minimum) • Secure, automated delivery of purchased files with license-key support • Clear admin workflows for adding new products, coupons, and reports • Basic on-page SEO and performance tuning so pages load fast • Documentation so I can maintain everything after hand-over

item.title: Shopify Adult Toy Dropship Setup
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I’m ready to launch an online adult-toy boutique on Shopify and need your help turning the idea into a fully functioning store. My vision board pinpoints a modern, sleek, feminism-positive aesthetic—clean lines, confident imagery, and a welcoming palette that avoids anything cliché or tacky. All design choices, from typography to icon sets, should echo that vibe.
Core tasks • Build the Shopify storefront, applying the look and feel from my vision board. • Connect 1on1 Wholesale Ltd as the exclusive dropshipping source, so products, stock counts, and order data flow automatically. • Activate Wallidpay as the primary payment gateway; I’m intentionally steering clear of PayPal or Stripe unless a fallback is required. • Configure essential pages (About, FAQ, Shipping & Returns, Privacy, T&C) and ensure age-verification on entry. • Test end-to-end: visitor lands on site, adds to cart, pays through Wallidpay, and the order reaches 1on1 Wholesale without manual intervention.
Acceptance The project is complete when the site is live at my domain, passes a full test order, and mirrors the design language captured in my vision board across desktop and mobile. If you’re confident with Shopify themes, Liquid tweaks, and third-party app integrations, I’d love to collaborate.

item.title: Web Design B2B Appointment Setter (Commission-based)
item.description:
750-1500 GBP | TITLE Remote B2B Appointment Setter – Commission on Every Sale (UK Web Design Studio)
DESCRIPTION Evenlit is a new UK web design studio (Fabli Ltd). We build bespoke websites for businesses of any size, with optional care plans covering hosting and ongoing changes. Projects typically range from £1,500 to £20,000+.
We are looking for remote appointment setters to find UK businesses that need a new or better website and book a short video or phone call with our sales lead. You do not need to sell, quote or close. Our sales lead handles the meeting and the deal.
WHAT YOU EARN - 20% of everything the client pays us: the website build AND their care plan. - Example: a £3,000 website = £600 to you. A £20,000 project = £4,000. - Commission is paid when the client's payment has cleared, through Freelancer milestones. If a client is refunded, the matching commission is refunded too.
WHAT YOU DO - Research UK businesses with an outdated, slow or missing website. - Contact them one to one (LinkedIn, phone, or a personal individual email). - Book a call with our sales lead using the booking link we give you. - Pass on short notes about each business before the call.
STRICT RULES (breaking any of these ends the agreement) - NO mass emails, bulk messaging or automated outreach of any kind. - NO quoting prices, discounts or estimates. Pricing is bespoke and only our sales lead discusses it. - NO promising timeframes or delivery dates. - NO promising features or results we have not agreed. - Phone outreach must follow UK rules: numbers screened against the TPS and CTPS registers before calling. - Represent Evenlit honestly. Never claim to be an employee.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience in B2B appointment setting or lead generation (please share results, not just job titles). - Fluent written and spoken English. - Understands the UK business market.
This is self-employed, commission-only work. There is no fixed fee or retainer.
TO APPLY Start your reply with the word "lamplight" so we know you read this. Then answer these in your own words (copy-paste and generic proposals will be ignored): 1. How would you find 10 UK businesses that need a new website this week? Be specific. 2. Write the first message you would send to one of them. 3. What is the best result you have achieved as an appointment setter? Give numbers.
SKILLS Lead Generation, Appointment Setting, B2B Sales, LinkedIn Marketing, Telemarketing, Cold Calling

item.title: Modern Chauffeur Booking Website Build
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I’m planning a compact, 4–5-page site that lets clients learn about my chauffeur services and secure a ride through a straightforward online booking form. The overall look should be modern and sleek—think clean lines, generous white space, and subtle motion or micro-interactions where they add polish without slowing the experience. I’m flexible on colours, so feel free to suggest a palette that reinforces a premium, trustworthy feel while staying accessible.
Core pages I foresee: • Home / Landing • Services (includes detailed vehicle & chauffeur info) • Book Now (interactive form that captures journey details, date, time, passenger count, contact, and auto-confirms via email) • About / Contact If an extra FAQ or testimonials section fits naturally, we can fold it in, but the key is keeping navigation simple.
Build-wise, I’m open: WordPress + Elementor/Bricks, Webflow, or a lightweight custom stack—whichever lets me tweak copy and pricing without touching code. The finished site must be: • Fully responsive and fast-loading (Google Core Web Vitals in the green) • SEO-ready with clean semantic markup and basic on-page optimisation • Secure (HTTPS, spam-protected forms, no exposed API keys)
When you hand it over, please include: • All source files and assets (Figma or XD if mockups are used) • Clear instructions for updating content and backing up the site • A quick screen-share or Loom walkthrough of the booking workflow configuration
If this aligns with your skill set, let me know your suggested tech stack, timeline, and any live chauffeur or service-industry sites you’ve built that show a similar aesthetic.

item.title: Affiliate Blog Setup on GoDaddy
item.description:

You’ll work directly in GoDaddy’s Website Builder / Managed WordPress environment (whichever is best within my plan) rather than migrating to WordPress.org, Blogger, or Wix. • Insert and track affiliate links seamlessly throughout posts and pages • Collect subscriber emails with a visible, GDPR-friendly opt-in form that feeds into the native GoDaddy Email Marketing tool (or Mailchimp/ConvertKit if easier to connect) • Optimise basic on-page SEO settings, URL structure, and mobile responsiveness • Provide a short video or written walk-through so I can add future articles and links myself
Once the site is live and tested, send me the hand-over pack (admin credentials, style guide, and your tutorial). That will serve as the acceptance criteria for project completion. Basically I have already setup my website I just need help setting up my affiliate marketing part. Im wanting the best most consistent paying affiliates. This could become an hourly, ongoing task

item.title: Minimalist Horsebox Marketplace Build
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I need horseboxsale.com built from the ground up as a dedicated marketplace for buying and selling horseboxes. Think of the core flow of dragondriving.co.uk, but stripped back to a clean, minimalistic interface that feels noticeably more professional and purpose-built for this single niche.
Key functionality I must have: • A robust listing system so sellers can add, edit or remove horseboxes with photos, price, spec and location. • Advanced, multi-criteria search filters (make, model, price range, regional radius, etc.) that return results quickly and cleanly. • Secure user accounts with profile pages for both private and trade sellers.
For communication, every listing should offer an on-site messaging inbox while also letting the seller decide whether to show their phone number or email. All conversations need to stay tied to the user’s account so I can track and moderate as needed.
Please build it fully responsive, load fast on mobile, and make administration simple: I want to approve or reject new listings, spotlight featured ads and see basic analytics from one dashboard.
Deliverables I expect: 1. Design mock-ups confirming the minimalist look and feel. 2. Full website build (front-end + back-end) on a platform you recommend, deployed to my hosting. 3. Handover of source code, documentation and a quick call or video walkthrough showing me how to manage listings, users and messages.
If you have recent marketplace examples—especially vehicle classifieds—share them so I can gauge fit. Let’s get this live quickly and cleanly.

We are a Canadian private career college looking for an experienced and reliable Moodle Developer to customize and support our learning management system.
